derived.p: NHC 5-km wind speed probability contours (cumulative, 120 h): the band a point falls in; for a municipio, the highest band touching it
derived.a: hours after the advisory when the official forecast 34-kt / 64-kt wind radii, interpolated hourly, first reach the place (-1: not within 72 h). NHC publishes its own arrival-time graphics; this is a stand-in computed from its radii
derived.slide: USGS OFR 2020-1022 susceptibility class at the point (Garita sampling); slide25 = highest class within 25 m
derived.roads: OpenStreetMap roads (motorway..tertiary) sampled every ~40 m against the USGS landslide map: km on High or above; bridges: OSM bridges on public roads, midpoint in a FEMA 1% zone or ends on High+ susceptibility

sources.shelters: Departamento de la Vivienda de Puerto Rico, Refugios, Temporada de Huracanes 2026 (via Garita)
sources.facilities: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL: hospitals, clinics, fire, police, power plants, substations, water plants, airports, seaports (via Garita)
sources.housing: HUD Public Housing Developments; HUD Multifamily Assisted Properties (via Garita)
sources.svi: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022, Puerto Rico tracts and municipios (via Garita)
sources.buildings: OpenStreetMap footprints plus machine-detected footprints (Google Open Buildings, Microsoft) via Overture Maps; exposure computed by Garita
sources.surge: NOAA NHC National Storm Surge Risk Maps, Puerto Rico (SLOSH MOM, high tide, 2018)
sources.slide: USGS Open-File Report 2020-1022 (Hughes and Schulz, 2020), landslide susceptibility
sources.empower: HHS emPOWER Program, Medicare beneficiaries with electricity-dependent durable medical equipment, by municipio (HHS_emPOWER_REST_Service_Public)
sources.ia: OpenFEMA Housing Assistance (owners and renters), DR-4671-PR Hurricane Fiona, by municipio (via Garita)
sources.roads: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL, Geofabrik Puerto Rico extract
sources.land: Natural Earth 10 m land (public domain); US Census TIGER municipio boundaries for Puerto Rico
